scope: Actual KL joint lower semicontinuity under narrow convergence of probability measures. Bounded measurable Fenchel test bound implies absolute continuity via indicator tests; clipped-log-density nonnegative dual integrands converge pointwise to klFun, and Fatou gives actual KL bound. L1 approximation under mu+nu with bounded continuous clipping proves continuous-test characterization. Joint narrow convergence of tests gives actual KL<=liminf KL, hence eventual uniform entropy bounds persist.
hypotheses: Measurable dual characterization requires only probability measures. Continuous-test and narrow results require normal Borel topological space and weak regularity of the sum of the limit laws; nontrivial filter. No absolute continuity, finite entropy, or target LSC hypotheses are assumed.
